## About
All Auto and Truck Specialists, Inc. is a friendly repair shop in Campbell, owned and operated by Perry Long. Before it carried this name, it was Mazda Honda Specialists, run by Perry's father, Robert Long, right here at the same location.
Perry started out working for his father and did everything from customer service to complete engine teardown and rebuilds. When Robert decided to turn his passion for working on cars into a hobby, he retired and sold the shop to Perry.
Today we handle mileage services, check engine lights, emission diagnostics, A/C, tires, alignments, welding and fabrication, plus an on-site Dynojet dyno. We're rated 4.7 on Google from 34 reviews.

## Services
- Check engine light: We track down why your check engine light is on.
- Emission diagnostics and repair: Diagnosing and repairing emission problems.
- A/C repair and service: Repair and service for your car or truck's air conditioning.
- Flat tire repairs: Repairs for flat tires.
- 2 wheel and 4 wheel alignments: Precision alignments on our Snap-On/John Bean alignment machine.
- Dyno runs: Put your car on our Dynojet dyno and see how much power you're making at the wheels.
- Rent our dyno: Want to rent our dyno for your own tuning? Contact us for details.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book dyno time or ask about rentals?
A: Email us at allautoandtruckspecialists@gmail.com or call 408-374-3690.

Q: What should I check before bringing my car for dyno runs?
A: Make sure your car is mechanically sound, put street tires (not slicks) on the drive wheels, and check your oil, coolant and gas.

Q: What kinds of vehicles can go on your dyno?
A: Our Dynojet dyno is designed to test both rear wheel drive and front wheel drive vehicles.
